split: q01-q15 dev (chapters I-X), q16-q20 test (chapters XI-XII); corpus shared, no claims of document-level independence
selection: Maximize dev Evidence Hit@3, then dev Hit@1, then fewer chunks, then strategy name. Freeze winner before any test retrieval.
store: Qdrant local persistent, cosine, exact search, top_k=3
coherence_sampling: First 10 ascending source units, normalized character offset len(text)//2; review all chunks covering each position
metadata_filter: Only chapter supplied explicitly in question; no gold source/page in filters
annotation: tool-assisted source and trace review is disclosed separately from pending student manual review. Never substitute exact match for manual coherence/grounding.
